select openid as openId, crm_custno as crmCustNo, ec_custno as ecCustNo,cmfuserid as cmfUserId, bindstat as bindStat, defaultbankno as defaultBankNo, TO_CHAR(bindtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS bindTime, TO_CHAR(INSERTTIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS insertTime, TO_CHAR(UPDATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM cmf_weixin_userinfoex WHERE OPENID = #{openId}
AND BINDSTAT = #{stat}

select openid as openId, crm_custno as crmCustNo, ec_custno as ecCustNo,cmfuserid as cmfUserId, bindstat as bindStat, defaultbankno as defaultBankNo, TO_CHAR(bindtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS bindTime, TO_CHAR(INSERTTIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS insertTime, TO_CHAR(UPDATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM cmf_weixin_userinfoex WHERE CMFUSERID = #{cmfUserId}
AND BINDSTAT = #{stat}

SELECT A.OPENID as openId, A.CRM_CUSTNO as crmCustNo, A.EC_CUSTNO as ecCustNo,A.CMFUSERID as cmfUserId, A.BINDSTAT as bindStat, A.DEFAULTBANKNO as defaultBankNo, TO_CHAR(A.BINDTIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS bindTime, TO_CHAR(A.INSERTTIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS insertTime, TO_CHAR(A.UPDATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM CMF_WEIXIN_USERINFOEX A WHERE A.OPENID = (SELECT T.OPENID FROM CMF_WEIXIN_USERINFO T WHERE T.USERID = #{userId})
SELECT OPENID AS openId FROM CMF_WEIXIN_USERINFO U WHERE U.STATUS='1' AND U.OPENID IN ( SELECT E.OPENID FROM CMF_WEIXIN_USERINFOEX E WHERE E.CMFUSERID=#{cmfUserId} AND E.BINDSTAT='R' )

SELECT EX.RISK_EVAL_STATUS riskEvalStatus, EX.REGISTER_STATUS registrStatus, EX.RISK_CODE riskCode, EX.PURCHASE_STATUS purchaseStatus, EX.LAST_RISK_EVAL_DATE lastRiskEvalDate, EX.CREATE_DATE createDate, EX.CREATE_BY createdBy, EX.UPDATE_DATE updateDate, EX.UPDATE_BY updateBy, EX.CMFUSERID cmfUserId, EX.CUSTNO custNo, EX.BUY_ONLINE buyOnLine, EX.BUY_OFFLINE buyOffLine, EX.REAL_NAME_STATUS realNameStatus FROM CMWA_WX_USER_INFO_EXTEND EX WHERE 1 = 1
AND EX.OPENID=#{dto.openId}
